title: Lodge or manage a residential rental bond (tenants)
summary: This page provides information on how tenants can lodge, manage, and claim refunds for residential rental bonds.
who_can_apply: Tenants who are lodging or managing a residential rental bond.
Tenants who are seeking a refund of a residential rental bond after a tenancy has ended.
what_you_need: A Rental Bonds Online account to check status, pay, and submit claims.
Details regarding any money owed to the landlord or agent, or evidence of damage/expenses related to the property, if claiming a refund.

external_links.text: Claim for refund of bond money – PDF

internal_links.text: pay your bond directly to your landlord or agent

faqs.q: How can I manage or check my residential rental bond?
faqs.a: You can check your status and progress, pay your bond online directly to NSW Fair Trading, and submit a claim for a refund online through your Rental Bonds Online account.

faqs.q: What happens if I need to get my bond back at the end of my tenancy?
faqs.a: You may need to submit a claim if you owe the landlord or agent money, or if there is damage or other expenses relating to the property.

faqs.q: How do I submit a claim for my bond refund?
faqs.a: You can submit a claim by email to bondclaims@customerservice.nsw.gov.au, by post to Locked Bag 9000, Grafton NSW 2460, or in person at any Service NSW Centre.
